requirements.requirement: There exists a strategy video game that has a release.
A downloadable content pack was released for that strategy video game more than three years after the strategy video game's release.
The downloadable content pack made changes to the mechanics of the base game, including changes to religion and technology, and introduced new mechanics for a specific playable European nation.
A Master's thesis was written on the theme of postcolonialism in that strategy video game for an American University in 2023.
That Master's thesis was advised by an academic who completed two degrees at a California University and published a 2020 monograph on the subject of video games.
The downloadable content pack has credited content designers, and the third content designer credited for that downloadable content pack is the person whose full name is requested.
